home.heroSubtitle: Building families in love and growing in truth
home.videosSubtitle: Worship through music and let life be lit by love
home.aboutBody: Hallelujah Home Church values family, worship, and truth, building relationships of love, forming mature disciples, and sharing the gospel with more people.

about.historyIntro: From the vision of family altars, the home church has walked step by step into mission, formation, and pastoral care. This timeline preserves key moments as a readable story of life passed on.

vision.intro: The home church vision begins with life multiplying through relationships: one to three, three to twelve, twelve to seventy, and then to the harvest God prepares. Church is not first a building; it is a people who carry witness, formation, and blessing wherever they go.

sections.title: Unity and Mission
sections.body: Home Church is built to bring people into unity with God and one another in Christ, and to carry God's love outward as a blessing to the people around us.

sections.title: Mission for Chinese communities, Chinese communities for mission
sections.body: The vision reaches Chinese-speaking communities wherever they are, not as a political or geographic idea, but as a call to carry the gospel with shared heritage, responsibility, and love.

sections.title: Shared life, love and equipping, anointing passed on

cards.title: Shared life
cards.body: A community where people can be honest, received, supported, and built together as the body of Christ.

cards.title: Love and equipping
cards.body: Building one another in love and helping each saint serve from the right place.

cards.title: Anointing passed on
cards.body: Every person is formed by spiritual parents and learns to raise spiritual children for the mission entrusted by God.

sections.title: Mission, Spirit-filled theology, team ministry, discipleship

cards.title: Mission-led
cards.body: Formation serves mission, equipping people to live as spiritual parents and as salt and light.

cards.title: Spirit-filled theology
cards.body: God's word is lived and experienced as people are filled by the Spirit day by day.

cards.title: Team ministry
cards.body: The church is the body of Christ, where gifts and callings become visible through service and connection.

cards.title: Discipleship
cards.body: Disciples follow pastors, pastors follow Paul, and Paul follows Christ, so formation can continue across generations.

lines: Listen to me, you islands; hear this, you distant nations: Before I was born the Lord called me; from my mother’s womb he has spoken my name. He made my mouth like a sharpened sword, in the shadow of his hand he hid me; he made me into a polished arrow and concealed me in his quiver. He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will display my splendor.”

And now the Lord says— he who formed me in the womb to be his servant to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to himself, for I am honored in the eyes of the Lord and my God has been my strength— he says: “It is too small a thing for you to be my servant to restore the tribes of Jacob and bring back those of Israel I have kept. I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth.”
